subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: Should OpenClaw persist an explicitly marked native compaction result produced immediately after safety-timeout cancellation while the wrapper-owned acceptance window remains open?
rationale: The implementation can mechanically restrict acceptance to the exact timeout reason, but choosing whether timeout-aborted work may mutate persisted session state is a product and reliability policy decision.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: Restore the shared Pi dependency, retain the exact timeout-scoped acceptance window, and land after focused sibling and exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Keep native timeout fail-closed
options.body: Keep inner chunk partial-summary recovery and timeout guidance but remove the AgentSession post-timeout commit path.

options.title: Require live gateway proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a realistic slow-provider or full gateway run demonstrates recovery without stale or duplicate session state.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: Restore the shared Pi dependency, retain the exact timeout-scoped acceptance window, and land after focused sibling and exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to vincentkoc and recent history makes him the clearest available owner for compaction timeout policy and sibling-runtime coordination.
